$why: Limits for scripts/site/read-check.mjs. Change one only with a reason in the commit message.
$minPx: Body text at least 16 CSS px: the common baseline for screen reading, and the size below which phones zoom a focused field.
$minLeading: Line height at least 1.4 times the text size, so the eye finds the next line; long-form guidance runs 1.4 to 1.6.
$measure: 45 to 75 characters per line at desktop (Bringhurst's span for running text; about 66 reads best). A phone column is narrower by nature, so only a floor of 30.
